asset.name: Text
asset.description: The semantic typography primitive exposing tokenized text styles with truncation, balancing, muted treatment, numeric alignment, and locale-aware rendering.

requires.reason: Every spacing, size, and radius value resolves to a declared ramp rather than a literal.

rationale: Text styles are bundled tokens pairing size, line height, weight, and tracking. Exposing them as one choice rather than four is what keeps typography consistent without per-component judgment.
